desc: The ATN BinoX 4K 4-16x combined with our cutting edge Dual Core Processor, gives you unsurpassed image quality with richer and more vivid color tones. With the built-in laser rangefinder/IR illuminator. Not only do you have the ability to see both day and night at your fingertips, but you now have the ability to range your target with absolute accuracy. BIX (Ballistic Information Exchange) tech allows systems to talk to each other, exchanging valuable information; in order to facilitate a shooting solution eliminating hold over. Features video recording in 4K, dual stream video, ultra low power consumption and interpupillary adjustment.
